Subject: OptimaHealth MAP: first draft + recommended milestones (post-discovery)

Hi Lena / Devon — thanks again for the call earlier. As promised, attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones we discussed plus owners and dependencies. Highlights below; full matrix in the attached file (20260830-OptimaHealth-MAP-v1.xlsx).

Key milestones (proposed):
- M1: Technical evaluation kickoff — OptimaHealth (Eng), Redwood SE — target: 2026-09-07
- M2: SOC2 & data handling review — OptimaHealth (Security), Redwood Security — target: 2026-09-21
- M3: Pilot integration & performance run — OptimaHealth (Platform), Redwood Infra — target: 2026-10-12
- M4: Contract review & PO issuance — OptimaHealth (Procurement), Redwood Sales — target: 2026-11-30

Ownership notes: Redwood will lead M1 and M3 execution support; OptimaHealth to provide test data and platform access for the pilot. Primary dependencies are SOC2 evidence and scheduled time from OptimaHealth platform engineers.

Target close: Nov 30, 2026 (PO signed / pilot acceptance).

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm owners for M1 and M2 (reply-all).
2) Confirm the PO target date still looks feasible for your procurement window.
3) Share any additional compliance documents we should attach to the MAP (e.g., internal Sourcing checklist).

Attachments: 20260830-OptimaHealth-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP draft); Redwood-security-one-pager.pdf

Thanks,

Thanks, Soojin — helpful summary and appreciate the clear owners. A couple of updates from our side: our Q4 procurement budget was paused last week pending an executive reprioritization across several vendor projects. That means the PO timeline will likely shift. Current internal ask is to move vendor commitments into the January procurement cycle.

Immediate implications we need you to consider:
- The target close will likely move to late Jan 2027 (we're proposing Jan 31, 2027).
- We need a phased MAP that allows us to start the technical evaluation and pilot work in Q4 without a signed PO (technical validation only).
- Please include a clear compliance gate for any early access to PII-like test data — security will only allow scoped test datasets until SOC2 evidence is validated.

I've attached our procurement timeline (procurement_timeline.pdf) for context.

Can you rework the MAP to show a phased approach and a shifted close date? Also please flag any cost or staffing implications for the pilot if we proceed before PO approval.

—Lena

Lena — thanks for the heads up and for the procurement timeline. I've updated the MAP to reflect a phased engagement and shifted target close to Jan 31, 2027. See the summary below and the revised MAP attached (20260902-OptimaHealth-MAP-v2.xlsx).

Revised plan (phased):
Phase 0 (non-production validation, no PO required)
- P0.1: Security scoping call (deliverable: allowed test dataset spec) — Owner: OptimaHealth Security — target: 2026-09-14
- P0.2: SE-led technical sandbox (Redwood provides sandbox access, limited tokens) — Owner: Redwood SE — target: 2026-09-28

Phase 1 (pilot, limited production-like testing)
- P1.1: Pilot integration & performance run (requires scoped access) — Owner: OptimaHealth Platform / Redwood Infra — target: 2026-11-16
- P1.2: Pilot acceptance criteria & performance sign-off — Owner: OptimaHealth Product — target: 2026-11-30

Phase 2 (contract & procurement)
- P2.1: Contract redlines & procurement approvals — Owner: OptimaHealth Procurement / Redwood Sales — target: 2027-01-31 (new close target)

Dependencies and notes:
- SOC2 / security evidence remains a gating dependency for any test data with sensitive attributes. Redwood can provide redacted logs and a security one-pager in P0.
- If you want earlier performance numbers we can run a synthetic throughput test in our sandbox to give you expected latency/cost ranges. That would not require a PO.
- Cost implication: running an extended sandbox pilot (beyond 2 weeks) may incur nominal usage charges; we'll surface any expected charges before the pilot begins.

Immediate asks for OptimaHealth:
1) Confirm new target close date of 2027-01-31 (reply-all).
2) Confirm owners for P0.1 and P1.1 so we can lock calendar invites.
3) Confirm whether you want a synthetic throughput run during P0.2.

Attachments: 20260902-OptimaHealth-MAP-v2.xlsx

Looking forward — happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Soojin Lee
